errors.description: The drawing's red-highlighted feature — which by the prompt's own convention marks WHERE the option sits — is a SHORT, NARROW pointed tab of roughly 1:2.5 width-to-length, topstitched around its outline, carrying ONE button close to its point. The render instead produced a full-length strap spanning the entire shoulder from collar to armhole. The pointed buttoned tab exists only as the terminal 15% of that strap. Short highlighted tab and full-span strap are not the same object.
errors.expected: a short narrow pointed tab, roughly 1:2.5 width-to-length, as red-highlighted in the drawing
errors.actual: a full-shoulder-span topstitched strap running collar to armhole, terminating in a pointed buttoned tab; verified by cropping the shoulder at 3x

errors.description: In the drawing the pointed tab emerges from a seam and its point faces AWAY from that seam into open cloth, with the button sitting at the point end. In the render the pointed end with the button sits at the OUTBOARD end, hard against the armhole/sleeve-head seam at the shoulder point, with the strap's plain end running inboard under the collar. The defining pointed-and-buttoned end is at the opposite end of the span from what the drawing indicates.
errors.expected: pointed buttoned end positioned as drawn, point directed away from the seam it springs from
errors.actual: pointed buttoned end at the outboard shoulder point abutting the armhole seam; plain end disappears under the collar — verified at 6x magnification

errors.description: The drawing contains, besides the red pointed tab, a wide topstitched band ending in a ROUNDED corner carrying a horizontal buttonhole, and a second long topstitched band carrying a vertical buttonhole. Neither of those elements, nor their spatial relationship to the red tab, appears anywhere in the render. Only the pointed tab was reproduced; the rest of the drawn assembly was dropped.

errors.actual: only a pointed buttoned tab on a plain strap; no rounded buttonholed band, no second buttonholed band, no equivalent relationship

errors.description: The drawn tab point is a symmetric pentagon — parallel sides converging to a centred apex. The rendered point is a shallow asymmetric chamfer in which the upper edge runs nearly straight through and only the lower edge angles up to meet it.
errors.actual: shallow asymmetric chamfered point, apex off-centre toward the upper edge — verified at 6x
